name: Piano Hero
description: Learn real songs on the piano one short part at a time. The notes fall toward the keys like in a rhythm game, and every part has three steps: Learn waits for each note, In rhythm slows down by itself when you miss, and For real is full speed. A star on a part opens the next one, and once every part has a star you play the whole song. Each song comes in Easy, Medium and Hard (both hands). Play with your computer keyboard or tap the keys. The piano is the Salamander Grand Piano by Alexander Holm (CC BY 3.0).
author: Joao Henrique Costa Araujo

types.name: Piano Hero
types.description: Falling-notes piano game with a song library and a progression: each song is cut into short parts with three steps (learn with the game waiting, in rhythm with a tempo that adapts, at full speed), one star each. Plays from a MIDI keyboard, the computer keyboard or clicks. ✓ Terminar records the session.
